name: quick-replies
description: Turns Claude Code's suggested next message into a button above the prompt. Click it or type 1 to send it.

enabled.title: Show suggestions
enabled.description: Claude Code's suggested next message as a button above Clawd. Also /replies on|off.

more.title: More suggestions
more.description: After each answer a fork of the session adds suggestions, up to four buttons. Costs about one short answer, mostly cached. Also /replies more on|off.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: 2 × 2 when the labels fit, otherwise one per row. grid: always 2 × 2. list: always one per row.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts and the fork prompt. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /replies language.
